We saw ~60% higher p99 latency and a sustained error rate spike on the inference route between 08:45 and 09:10 EDT this morning. Several downstream jobs retried and some customers saw timeouts. Platform ops flagged a queue backlog and we experienced request drops.

This hit our night-batch window and created missed SLAs for three of our clinics. We need an RCA and a short executive summary for our CTO by EOD tomorrow. Can you confirm next steps and expected timeline for remediation and any goodwill credits?

-Alex

Subject: Re: Production impact — preliminary timeline and mitigation

Team / Alex — preliminary findings below (full timeline attached).

Summary: between 08:44:23 and 09:09:58 EDT we observed a confluence of:
- a sudden spike of long-sequence requests (90%ile seq len increased from 512->4096)
- concurrent autoscaler lag on a subset of Dedicated pool nodes during a cache warm-up window
- a small regression in our KV cache eviction heuristics after a rolling config change at 08:40 (internal rollout ID: rld-20270428-0815)

Impact: increased scheduling latency -> batching stalls -> request retries -> elevated 5xx rate. We mitigated by rolling back rld-20270428-0815 at 09:02 and temporarily increasing the Dedicated pool burst floor; error rate reduced to baseline by ~09:20.

Next steps (48h):
1) Full RCA doc + annotated timeline (deliverable: Marissa, due: 2027-04-29 16:00 EDT) — attached prelim.
2) Action tracker (deliverable: cross-functional owners, due: see tracker) — attached.
3) Immediate config guardrail: pin eviction heuristic until regression fully validated (owner: Marcus).
4) Canary and autoscaler tuning work (owner: SRE).

Attachments: luminar_prelim_rca_20270429.pdf; luminar_action_tracker_20270429.xlsx

Marissa Cole
SRE, Redwood Inference

Preliminary cause: cache eviction heuristic regression combined with autoscaler cold-start behavior for long sequences.

Proposed customer remediation:
- One month credit for missed SLA (proposal: 30% of April inference spend, pending finance sign-off).
- Postmortem + 30-day remediation commitment and weekly checkpoints.
- Priority roadmap slot for autoscaler/canary improvements.

- guidance on whether we should proactively offer a technical postmortem session with Luminar CTO (Laura)

If we can close these two by EOD tomorrow, I’ll send the customer-facing exec summary and finalize the HubSpot note (HS-4821).

Subject: Final: Luminar incident closure, RCA attached, and action follow-through

Alex / Tom — thanks again for your patience. Closing note and next steps:

What happened (tl;dr): a config regression in our KV eviction heuristic hit during a long-sequence spike which, in combination with autoscaler cold starts, caused batching stalls and a transient 5xx spike. We rolled the config back and raised Dedicated burst floor which restored normal service by 09:20 EDT.

Deliverables attached: final RCA (luminar_final_rca_20270502.pdf) and the action tracker with owners, dates, and closure notes. Key committed items (owners and ETA):
- Canary: 2% pre-rollout traffic gate (Owner: Marcus Lin — ETA: 2027-05-07)
- Autoscaler readiness test & tuning (Owner: Marissa Cole — ETA: 2027-05-10)
- Rollout guard (pin eviction heuristic for 30 days post-change) (Owner: Engineering) — in tracker
- Customer credit: pending finance; we will confirm amount by 2027-05-04

We’d like to schedule a 30-minute technical readout with your CTO next week to walk through the timeline and mitigation plan. Proposed times: Wed 2027-05-05 10:00–10:30 PDT or Thu 2027-05-06 13:00–13:30 PDT. Please let me know what works.

Thank you again — we take this very seriously and will share weekly progress against the action tracker until all items are closed.

—Karthik
